experiments.story: A coding agent sets up a signup-form test. Gatekeeper stops the broken first version, waits for a person, and refuses an early winner.

timeline.detail: flag signup_form, metric signup_completed, experiment #3 (not started)

spec.hypothesis: Asking for 3 fields instead of 6 gets more visitors to finish signing up.

findings.title: Events are not enabled
findings.why: The SDK only records exposures and conversions when events are enabled. Without it the experiment shows zero visitors.
findings.fix: Create the client with enable_events=True (Python) or enableEvents: true (JavaScript).

findings.title: No default flag handler
findings.why: When Flagsmith cannot be reached, a client without a default handler has no value to serve, so the page can break or render nothing for some visitors.
findings.fix: Pass default_flag_handler (Python) or defaultFlags (JavaScript) with the control value.

findings.title: A new visitor ID is made on every request
findings.why: Bucketing is deterministic on the identifier. A fresh random ID per request puts the same person in a different group on every page view and counts them many times.
findings.fix: Create the ID once, store it (cookie, local storage, session or user ID) and reuse it.

findings.detail: conversion uses email; exposure uses visitor_id
findings.title: Exposure and conversion use different identifiers
findings.why: Flagsmith joins exposures and conversions per identity. If they are sent under different IDs, no conversion is ever matched to a variation.
findings.fix: Send track_event with the same identifier that was passed to get_experiment_flag.

findings.title: Self-hosted API but events still go to Flagsmith Cloud
findings.why: Setting the API URL does not move events. Without an events URL the SDK posts events to Cloud and the self-hosted warehouse never sees them.
